result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice ('we aim', 'we care deeply') with absolute phrasing ('we strive to always'). Patients and innovation lead; employees, community and DEI follow in brief commitments. Financial returns are absent and sustainability appears only once. Headings like 'Our principles' and 'Equity, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion' frame the values.
